answer: To forge a sybil swarm, an attacker must fund dozens of independent stakes plus sponsor collateral, all slashable if peers detect duplicate behavior patterns. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked for the epoch, and every new identity requires a sponsor to co-sign, forming a trust harbor where reputation accrues only through verified work. This makes the marginal cost of each fake identity exceed the reward from any single epoch's attestations. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
